problems.quote: If the total work on each project is known (or can be taken as LCM), solve for a, b, c.
problems.problem: With only two pairwise combined rates (a+b and b+c) and three unknown efficiencies (a,b,c), the system is underdetermined; individual efficiencies cannot be solved uniquely even if total works W1 and W2 are known.
problems.correction: A third independent equation is needed to solve for a, b, c.
problems.verifierReason: Original quote wrongly implies two equations suffice; three unknowns require three independent equations.
